skill_name: What is the legal principle behind copyright law?
workflow: The legal principle behind copyright law is that it grants creators exclusive control over the reproduction and distribution of their creative works. This means that anyone who wishes to publish or otherwise make use of a creative work must first obtain permission from the copyright holder. Copyright law seeks to balance the interests of creators and users of creative works by granting exclusive rights to the creator while also allowing use of the work in certain circumstances.
